benchmark.name: PID2Graph OPEN100
benchmark.scope: all 12 complete public real OPEN100 plans

protocol.localization: class-agnostic one-to-one IoU >= 0.50; maximize eligible matches then total IoU; micro P/R/F1
protocol.predicted_coordinate_convention: inclusive maxima converted by +1 for interval-area IoU; native GraphML unchanged
protocol.connectivity: collapse connector/crossing-only reference components to adjacent physical-symbol pairs; compare accepted-edge components separately within every predicted net; no closure through physical symbols
protocol.classes: tank and pump map to equipment only for a separate coarse-class diagnostic

preservation.audit: strict unique class/raw-box and export/trace exact mapping; no identifier/proximity/geometry fallback
preservation.limits: Preserves prior outputs and E/I/R relationships; does not certify correctness against OPEN100 annotation. Added relations are new pairs relative to exactly mapped old pairs; unmapped-object and unmapped-relation counts are separate from mapped losses.

execution.interpretation: Shared cached answers are not independent replicates. Request counts are trace measurements, not billing or independent latency.

paper_snapshot.title: Preserving Visual Evidence While Repairing Industrial Diagram Graphs
paper_snapshot.status: four-page short-paper draft; no conference acceptance or final conference submission claimed
paper_snapshot.validation: Source and PDF match the existing aligned draft hashes. Existing four rendered pages visually inspected at publication; layout, authors, equations, two figures and two tables visible without clipping. This is artifact inspection, not a new model run.

public_figure_provenance.modifications: original raster crops resized for presentation with distinct reference annotation boxes, annotation-node center polylines, saved predicted boxes/routes and captions
public_figure_provenance.selection_rule: For recovered and missed pairs separately: fixed plan order then lexicographic reference pair order, first full-reference-route bounding span <=700px; otherwise first available pair. Same legibility rule for both categories.

cases.category_meaning: recovered denotes an evaluated true positive, not a local-recovery decision or a v11-to-v12 gain
cases.overlay_note: Reference polyline joins native annotation node centers; prediction polylines are saved accepted extraction routes. Neither overlay entered verification.

cases.category_meaning: missed reference pair under the adapted evaluator
cases.overlay_note: Reference polyline joins native annotation node centers; prediction polylines are saved accepted extraction routes. Neither overlay entered verification.

limitations: Adapted symbol-net P/R/F1, not native PID2Graph AP/mAP.
No prior private drawing or private legend crop used as inference input.
Two versions use shared question cache; stochastic variation and intended repair effects are not isolated.
Ten raw candidate plans fail strict preservation; do not call the revision preservation-certified.
Incorrect preliminary two-plan coordinate pilot superseded.
OPEN100 is one related collection of 12 diagrams with solid reference edges. Hosted-model pretraining membership is undisclosed.
Later v15 API and private-case diagnostics are separate development evidence; this file reports no full v15 public evaluation.
The manuscript retains a WWW 2027 format header from the existing draft; it is not a publication or acceptance claim.
